name: battle-sea
description: Hot-seat Battleship for two players on one device, drawn with a blue pen on squared paper.

scripts.check:logic: vite build --ssr scripts/logic-check.ts --outDir node_modules/.logic-check --logLevel error && node node_modules/.logic-check/logic-check.js
scripts.check:render: vite build --ssr scripts/render-check.ts -c scripts/render-check.vite.config.ts --logLevel error && node node_modules/.render-check/render-check.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:logic && npm run check:render
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && cap run android
